subtopics.name: Process vs Thread
subtopics.explanation: A process has isolated memory and stronger fault boundaries. Threads share process memory and are cheaper for concurrent work.

problems.item: Given 8 product scenarios, choose process or thread and justify with isolation and memory cost.
Design a browser tab architecture using process and thread boundaries.
Analyze a crash report and redesign process-thread model to reduce blast radius.

subtopics.name: CPU Scheduling
subtopics.explanation: Scheduling decides which ready task gets CPU next. Main trade-offs are throughput, latency, fairness, and starvation.

problems.item: Compute waiting and turnaround time for FCFS and Round Robin for a small process table.
Choose scheduling policy for an API server and justify with workload profile.
Propose anti-starvation strategy for mixed interactive and batch jobs.

subtopics.name: Context Switch and System Calls
subtopics.explanation: Context switch saves and restores execution state. System calls move execution from user mode to kernel mode for privileged operations.

problems.item: Trace read() from user code to kernel and back with mode transitions.
Estimate overhead impact of frequent context switches in a chat server.
Optimize a syscall-heavy workload using batching and async IO.

subtopics.name: Mutex, Semaphore, and Monitor
subtopics.explanation: Mutex gives exclusive ownership, semaphore controls resource count, and monitor wraps shared state with synchronized methods.

problems.item: Identify correct primitive for printer pool, counter increment, and producer queue.
Implement bounded buffer with semaphores and explain race prevention.
Fix priority inversion in a lock-based service design.

subtopics.name: Deadlock Detection and Prevention
subtopics.explanation: Deadlock occurs when cyclic waits cannot resolve. Prevention breaks one Coffman condition; detection finds and recovers from cycles.

problems.item: Given lock acquisition order of threads, detect if deadlock is possible.
Design lock ordering for payment plus inventory plus notification workflows.
Build deadlock recovery playbook for DB and service-layer locks.

subtopics.name: Producer-Consumer and Reader-Writer
subtopics.explanation: These are canonical concurrency patterns to control throughput while preserving correctness under shared access.

problems.item: Model producer-consumer with finite queue and identify blocking points.
Implement reader-writer lock strategy for config cache service.
Redesign event pipeline to avoid writer starvation under burst reads.

subtopics.name: Virtual Memory and Paging
subtopics.explanation: Virtual memory gives each process a private address space and maps pages to physical frames on demand.

problems.item: Translate virtual address to physical address using a simple page table.
Explain demand paging behavior under memory pressure with page faults.
Diagnose thrashing in a multi-tenant node and propose mitigation.

subtopics.name: TLB and Page Replacement
subtopics.explanation: TLB caches page translations. Page replacement policies choose victim pages and directly impact latency and fault rate.

problems.item: Simulate FIFO and LRU page replacement for a given reference string.
Compare TLB hit ratio impact on request latency for two workloads.
Design memory policy for low-latency service with mixed hot and cold pages.

subtopics.name: Segmentation and Fragmentation
subtopics.explanation: Segmentation organizes memory by logical regions. Fragmentation wastes memory due to allocation patterns and layout constraints.

problems.item: Classify examples into internal or external fragmentation.
Propose allocator strategy for workload with frequent small object churn.
Design compaction and allocation policy for long-lived memory-intensive process.

subtopics.name: File Systems, Inodes, and Journaling
subtopics.explanation: File systems map filenames to metadata and blocks. Journaling improves crash recovery by writing intent before applying changes.

problems.item: Trace file open to inode lookup to block read in ext-style layout.
Design log sequence for safe rename and metadata update crash recovery.
Compare journaling vs copy-on-write under write-heavy workloads.

subtopics.name: Disk Scheduling and RAID
subtopics.explanation: Disk scheduling reduces seek latency, and RAID balances performance, availability, and usable capacity.

problems.item: Compute total head movement for FCFS and SSTF for a request queue.
Choose RAID level for analytics warehouse and justify trade-offs.
Plan degraded-mode read strategy after multiple disk failures.

subtopics.name: IPC: Signals, Pipes, and Shared Memory
subtopics.explanation: IPC mechanisms enable process communication with different latency and complexity profiles.

problems.item: Pick IPC method for parent-child status updates, stream data, and low-latency exchange.
Design worker pool using message queue plus graceful shutdown signal handling.
Debug race condition in shared-memory ring buffer with multiple producers.

subtopics.name: ER to Relational Mapping
subtopics.explanation: ER modeling captures entities and relationships; relational mapping turns them into tables, keys, and constraints.

problems.item: Convert a simple ER diagram (student-course) into normalized tables.
Model many-to-many with attributes and enforce uniqueness constraints.
Design schema for multi-tenant SaaS with audit and soft-delete support.

subtopics.name: Normalization (1NF to BCNF)
subtopics.explanation: Normalization reduces redundancy and update anomalies by decomposing tables based on dependencies.

problems.item: Identify anomalies in denormalized order table and suggest 2NF decomposition.
Decompose schema to 3NF while preserving dependencies.
Balance normalization and read performance for reporting-heavy workload.

subtopics.name: Keys and Constraints
subtopics.explanation: Primary, foreign, and unique keys enforce integrity. Constraints prevent invalid state at write time.

problems.item: Choose primary and candidate keys for a user-identity model.
Add foreign key and check constraints for order lifecycle state machine.
Design deferrable constraints strategy for bulk import pipelines.

subtopics.name: Joins and Grouping
subtopics.explanation: Joins combine related tables; grouping summarizes data. Correct join cardinality is critical for correctness and speed.

problems.item: Write INNER and LEFT JOIN queries for users and orders with missing orders case.
Produce top categories by revenue with HAVING filter and date constraints.
Diagnose duplicate rows in multi-join report and fix aggregation logic.

subtopics.name: Indexing
subtopics.explanation: Indexes speed reads by avoiding full scans but add storage and write overhead. Index choice must follow query patterns.

problems.item: Pick single-column index for a frequent WHERE plus ORDER BY query.
Design composite index for timeline query with user_id and created_at.
Eliminate slow query in high-write table without hurting ingestion throughput.

subtopics.name: Execution Plans
subtopics.explanation: Execution plans show how the optimizer will run your query. Reading cost, scan type, and join strategy is interview critical.

problems.item: Interpret plan nodes for simple filter query and identify table scan.
Rewrite query to push predicate earlier and reduce rows before join.
Compare two execution plans and justify optimizer behavior under stale stats.

subtopics.name: ACID and Transactions
subtopics.explanation: Transactions group operations into atomic units. ACID ensures consistency under failures and concurrency.

problems.item: Explain transfer workflow and where atomicity is required.
Design transaction boundaries for order placement with inventory decrement.
Handle partial failure in distributed payment plus order confirmation flow.

subtopics.name: Isolation Levels
subtopics.explanation: Isolation levels trade consistency anomalies against throughput. Know dirty read, non-repeatable read, and phantom read.

problems.item: Classify anomalies shown in transaction timeline examples.
Choose isolation level for wallet service with balance checks.
Resolve phantom-read bug without defaulting to serializable everywhere.

subtopics.name: Locking, Deadlocks, and MVCC
subtopics.explanation: Pessimistic and optimistic concurrency approaches solve different workloads. MVCC allows non-blocking reads with version visibility rules.

problems.item: Explain row lock vs table lock with simple update workload.
Diagnose deadlock logs and propose lock ordering fix.
Design retry and idempotency strategy for serializable transaction conflicts.

subtopics.name: Replication
subtopics.explanation: Replication improves availability and read scalability but introduces lag and consistency decisions.

problems.item: Explain leader-follower read flow with replication lag example.
Design read routing policy for session-consistent user dashboard.
Mitigate stale reads in multi-region checkout service.

subtopics.name: Sharding and Partitioning
subtopics.explanation: Sharding distributes data horizontally using a shard key. Good key choice avoids hotspots and uneven load.

problems.item: Compare range and hash partitioning for order table.
Pick shard key for social app and justify against hotspot risk.
Plan online resharding with minimal downtime and data correctness.

subtopics.name: WAL, Recovery, and Backup
subtopics.explanation: Write-ahead logging ensures recoverability. Backup and restore strategy defines RPO and RTO guarantees.

problems.item: Explain why log must be persisted before data page flush.
Design nightly backup plus binlog replay restore process.
Create disaster recovery runbook for region-level outage.

subtopics.name: OSI vs TCP/IP
subtopics.explanation: OSI is conceptual for troubleshooting; TCP/IP is the practical Internet stack used in real systems.

problems.item: Map DNS, TLS, HTTP, TCP, IP to correct layers.
Given packet loss symptoms, identify likely layer and first debug step.
Build layer-wise incident diagnosis flow for latency spikes.

subtopics.name: IP, Subnetting, and Routing
subtopics.explanation: IP addresses identify hosts; subnetting partitions networks; routing determines next hop across networks.

problems.item: Calculate network, broadcast, and host range for CIDR blocks.
Design subnet plan for three-tier application VPC.
Diagnose asymmetric routing issue causing intermittent failures.

subtopics.name: DNS, DHCP, and ARP
subtopics.explanation: DNS resolves names to IPs, DHCP assigns IP configuration, and ARP maps IP to MAC in local network.

problems.item: Trace website access path from DNS query to ARP resolution.
Debug DNS cache TTL issue causing stale endpoint resolution.
Design resilient internal DNS strategy for multi-region microservices.

subtopics.name: TCP Handshake and Reliability
subtopics.explanation: TCP provides ordered and reliable delivery using handshake, sequence numbers, ACKs, and retransmission.

problems.item: Explain SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK and why handshake is needed.
Analyze packet trace with retransmissions and identify root cause.
Tune reliable delivery for high-latency mobile network path.

subtopics.name: Flow and Congestion Control
subtopics.explanation: Flow control protects receiver capacity; congestion control protects network capacity and avoids collapse.

problems.item: Differentiate receiver window and congestion window with examples.
Reason about slow start and congestion avoidance for burst traffic.
Propose tuning strategy for throughput drops in long-haul links.

subtopics.name: UDP and QUIC
subtopics.explanation: UDP is minimal transport with no built-in reliability. QUIC builds secure and low-latency transport over UDP.

problems.item: Choose UDP or TCP for video call, file transfer, and telemetry.
Explain why HTTP/3 uses QUIC and where latency is saved.
Design packet loss recovery strategy for real-time game traffic.

subtopics.name: HTTP and HTTPS
subtopics.explanation: HTTP is request-response protocol; HTTPS adds TLS for confidentiality and integrity.

problems.item: Differentiate GET, POST, PUT, PATCH in API design examples.
Debug mixed-content and redirect loop issue in HTTPS migration.
Design secure session handling across multiple subdomains.

subtopics.name: WebSocket, SSE, and Polling
subtopics.explanation: These patterns serve different real-time needs: full duplex (WebSocket), server push (SSE), and periodic pull (polling).

problems.item: Pick protocol for stock ticker, chat, and background notifications.
Design reconnection strategy for flaky mobile clients.
Scale WebSocket gateway to millions of concurrent connections.

subtopics.name: Load Balancer, CDN, and Caching
subtopics.explanation: Load balancers distribute traffic, CDNs bring content closer to users, and cache strategy controls latency and origin load.

problems.item: Choose L4 vs L7 load balancing for three API patterns.
Design cache keys and TTL for product catalog endpoints.
Plan cache invalidation during flash sale price changes.

subtopics.name: TLS, PKI, and Certificates
subtopics.explanation: TLS secures transport; PKI establishes trust using certificate authorities and validation chains.

problems.item: Explain TLS handshake steps at high level.
Debug certificate mismatch and chain validation failure.
Design certificate rotation policy for service mesh with zero downtime.

subtopics.name: NAT, Firewalls, and VPN
subtopics.explanation: NAT translates addresses, firewalls enforce policy boundaries, and VPNs create secure tunnels over untrusted networks.

problems.item: Explain why private subnet instances need NAT for outbound Internet access.
Define firewall rules for public API and internal admin services.
Design site-to-site VPN failover architecture for hybrid cloud.

subtopics.name: Network Debugging
subtopics.explanation: Practical debugging uses packet path checks, DNS validation, latency decomposition, and traffic capture tools.

problems.item: Use ping and traceroute output to localize failure segment.
Diagnose API timeout by splitting DNS, connect, TLS, and server latency.
Create production runbook for intermittent packet loss across regions.

subtopics.name: Class, Object, and Encapsulation
subtopics.explanation: Classes model behavior and state; objects are runtime instances. Encapsulation protects invariants behind clear interfaces.

problems.item: Model bank account with private state and validated operations.
Refactor a god class into cohesive objects with clear responsibilities.
Design immutable domain entity strategy for concurrent reads.

subtopics.name: Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism
subtopics.explanation: Abstraction defines contracts, inheritance reuses behavior, and polymorphism enables interchangeable implementations.

problems.item: Design payment interface with card and UPI implementations.
Replace long switch-case with polymorphic dispatch.
Resolve fragile base class issue in existing inheritance tree.

subtopics.name: Composition over Inheritance
subtopics.explanation: Composition keeps modules flexible by assembling behavior through interfaces instead of deep class hierarchies.

problems.item: Refactor bird hierarchy where penguin cannot fly using composition.
Design notification engine with pluggable channels via composition.
Migrate legacy inheritance-heavy module to strategy-based architecture.

subtopics.name: SOLID: SRP, OCP, LSP
subtopics.explanation: These principles reduce change impact by separating concerns, extending behavior safely, and preserving substitutability.

problems.item: Find SRP violations in order service and split responsibilities.
Extend discount engine without modifying tested core classes.
Fix LSP break in subclass overriding contract behavior.

subtopics.name: SOLID: ISP and DIP
subtopics.explanation: ISP keeps interfaces focused; DIP inverts dependencies toward abstractions to improve testability and flexibility.

problems.item: Split bulky repository interface into read and write contracts.
Introduce dependency injection for payment gateway integration.
Decouple domain layer from framework-specific persistence code.

subtopics.name: Coupling and Cohesion
subtopics.explanation: Good design minimizes unnecessary dependencies and groups closely related behavior in the same module.

problems.item: Score coupling and cohesion of provided module boundaries.
Refactor service mesh to reduce cross-module call graph complexity.
Define bounded contexts for a monolith under rapid feature growth.

subtopics.name: Creational Patterns
subtopics.explanation: Factory, Abstract Factory, Builder, and Singleton manage object creation with controlled construction complexity.

problems.item: Use Factory pattern for parser selection by file format.
Apply Builder to construct configurable report pipeline object.
Redesign singleton-based global state into testable configurable provider.

subtopics.name: Structural Patterns
subtopics.explanation: Adapter, Decorator, Facade, and Composite organize class relationships for extensibility and cleaner integration.

problems.item: Wrap third-party logger API with Adapter for internal contract.
Add dynamic discount behavior using Decorator without subclass explosion.
Design service integration facade for payment plus fraud plus notification stack.

subtopics.name: Behavioral Patterns
subtopics.explanation: Strategy, Observer, Command, and State patterns model runtime behavior changes cleanly.

problems.item: Use Strategy for selecting shipping cost algorithm by region.
Design Observer-based event system for inventory updates.
Implement State pattern for multi-step order lifecycle with retries.

subtopics.name: Requirement to Class Diagram
subtopics.explanation: Convert ambiguous requirements into entities, responsibilities, and relationships before coding.

problems.item: Create class diagram for parking lot from a short requirement note.
Model elevator system with service contracts and invariants.
Design extensible ride-matching core with surge and assignment policies.

subtopics.name: State Modeling and Workflows
subtopics.explanation: State transitions prevent invalid behavior and make business workflows explicit and testable.

problems.item: Define valid state transitions for ticket booking lifecycle.
Implement retry plus timeout handling in asynchronous workflow state model.
Design saga-style compensation flow for distributed order pipeline.

subtopics.name: Refactoring, Testing, and Clean Code
subtopics.explanation: Interview-quality design includes maintainable code, focused tests, and iterative refactoring under changing requirements.

problems.item: Refactor duplicated logic into reusable object with unit tests.
Write test plan for failure paths and edge cases in payment module.
Perform safe large refactor with contract tests and backward compatibility.

subtopics.name: Filtering, Sorting, and LIMIT
subtopics.explanation: Start with deterministic result sets using WHERE, ORDER BY, and LIMIT for precise retrieval.

problems.item: Return top 5 highest salary employees in each city.
Filter active users in last 30 days and sort by engagement score.
Create stable pagination query for high-write feed table.

subtopics.name: Joins
subtopics.explanation: Joins combine data across entities. Master join types and cardinality to avoid duplicates and missing rows.

problems.item: List customers with zero orders using LEFT JOIN.
Compute order value by customer and payment status across three tables.
Fix over-counting issue in many-to-many join analytics query.

subtopics.name: GROUP BY, HAVING, and Aggregates
subtopics.explanation: Aggregation summarizes metrics per group. HAVING filters grouped output after aggregate computation.

problems.item: Find department-wise average salary and highest paid employee count.
Compute weekly active users by platform and filter weeks above threshold.
Build monthly revenue report with rolling quality checks and anomaly flags.

subtopics.name: Subqueries and CTE
subtopics.explanation: Subqueries compose logic in-place; CTEs improve readability and stepwise transformation of data.

problems.item: Find employees earning above department average using correlated subquery.
Use CTEs to compute conversion rate from visit to purchase funnel.
Rewrite nested query chain into optimized CTE pipeline.

subtopics.name: Window Functions
subtopics.explanation: Window functions compute analytics across partitions without collapsing rows.

problems.item: Rank employees by salary within each department.
Compute running revenue by month and region.
Find churn candidates using LAG on activity gaps with custom thresholds.

subtopics.name: CASE, NULL Handling, and Date Functions
subtopics.explanation: Production SQL relies on robust conditional logic, null-safe calculations, and correct date truncation and intervals.

problems.item: Bucket transactions into risk tiers using CASE expression.
Build week-over-week KPI table handling NULL values correctly.
Fix timezone and date-boundary bug in retention dashboard query.

subtopics.name: Ranking and Percentiles
subtopics.explanation: Use rank and percentile functions for distribution-aware analytics and benchmark reporting.

problems.item: Return top 3 products by region using DENSE_RANK.
Compute p50 and p95 order delivery time by city.
Design robust percentile query for skewed latency data with outliers.

subtopics.name: Recursive Queries
subtopics.explanation: Recursive CTEs solve hierarchical and graph-like traversal directly in SQL.

problems.item: List employee-manager hierarchy from CEO to leaves.
Generate category tree with depth and breadcrumb path.
Detect cycle in referral graph and return offending path.

subtopics.name: Performance and Index-Aware SQL
subtopics.explanation: Interview-level SQL includes query rewrites, index-aware predicates, and plan-based optimization.

problems.item: Rewrite non-sargable predicate to use index.
Optimize slow dashboard query by reducing sort and join cost.
Design query strategy for billion-row table under strict latency SLO.

subtopics.name: Cohort, Retention, and Funnel Analysis
subtopics.explanation: These are common analytics interview tasks requiring careful event definitions and time windows.

problems.item: Compute D1 retention by signup cohort week.
Build conversion funnel from view to add_to_cart to purchase.
Explain retention drop with segmented cohort analysis and query validation.

subtopics.name: Ledger and Reconciliation Queries
subtopics.explanation: Fintech and commerce interviews test balancing, mismatch detection, and idempotent reconciliation logic.

problems.item: Find transactions missing corresponding settlement records.
Reconcile gateway and internal ledger with tolerance thresholds.
Design daily reconciliation job query suite with failure rerun safety.

subtopics.name: SQL Debugging and Query Review
subtopics.explanation: Strong candidates can debug wrong results quickly and explain trade-offs in readability, correctness, and performance.

problems.item: Find bug in query caused by incorrect join key.
Review teammate query for NULL handling and grouping mistakes.
Refactor long business query into readable CTE pipeline while preserving output.
